description: Scala source code for the BlockStoreShuffleReader class in Apache Spark, responsible for fetching and reading shuffle blocks from other nodes' block stores, including batch fetching logic, stream deserialization, sorting, and aggregation.

classes.name: BlockStoreShuffleReader
classes.description: A class that reads shuffle data blocks from other nodes' block stores, with support for batch fetching, sorting, and aggregation.

methods.name: fetchContinuousBlocksInBatch
methods.description: Determines whether to fetch shuffle blocks in batch based on configuration and environment conditions.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and returns an iterator over the key-value pairs for a shuffle reduce task, handling stream fetching, deserialization, optional sorting, and aggregation.
